debrief db-021
1) the actor a-t-t-e-m-p-t-e-d to a-c-c-e-s-s c-u-s-t-o-m-e-r l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s for g-i-f-t c-a-r-d c-o-n-v-e-r-s-i-o-n-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a f-i-l-e-d e-x-h-i-b-i-t of the a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y p-l-a-n, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a-c-t-o-r i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.

2) the actor a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e m-o-v-e-m-e-n-t-s a-c-r-o-s-s a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s to m-i-m-i-c n-o-r-m-a-l s-h-o-p-p-i-n-g, l-e-a-v-i-n-g b-u-l-k t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n l-o-g-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a-n-o-m-a-l-y d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d t-u-n-i-n-g.

3) the actor c-o-n-v-e-r-t-e-d d-i-g-i-t-a-l b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s i-n-t-o c-a-s-h a-n-d g-o-o-d-s via t-h-i-r-d p-a-r-t-y m-e-r-c-h-a-n-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g i-n-v-o-i-c-e r-e-c-o-r-d-s for c-o-m-p-a-r-i-s-o-n, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g f-r-a-u-d r-u-l-e r-e-v-i-e-w of t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s.

4) the actor c-l-e-a-n-e-d p-a-r-t of the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-c-e by r-e-m-o-v-i-n-g t-e-m-p o-r-d-e-r f-i-l-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g f-i-l-e d-e-l-e-t-i-o-n e-n-t-r-y-s in the s-y-s-t-e-m j-o-u-r-n-a-l, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e l-o-g i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k-s.

5) the actor a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d the e-x-h-i-b-i-t u-n-d-e-r a c-l-o-s-e-d m-a-t-t-e-r r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e to i-m-p-l-y d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-a-v-i-n-g the m-a-t-t-e-r s-t-a-t-u-s f-l-a-g in the r-e-c-o-r-d, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g s-t-a-t-u-s v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n of the c-l-o-s-u-r-e r-e-a-s-o-n-s.
